title: MySQL and MariaDB replication observations 0.1.0
description: Replica-side evidence only. No credentials or rendered content.

source_id.description: UUID identifying the retention producer source.

observation_id.description: Source UUID plus deterministic hash of the raw execution observation identity.

recipe_id.description: Stable producing recipe ID, independent of its filesystem reference.

recipe_version.description: Executed recipe version, preserved for interpretation.

observed_at.description: Controller UTC timestamp after the probe response; not a database transaction timestamp.

max_delay_seconds.description: Maximum accepted replica-reported delay. Zero requires zero delay.

source_verification.description: No source-side connection, GTID coverage or data checksum was performed.

server.description: Authenticated database identity; independent of SSH account.

version.description: Server-reported database version, not the client version.

version_comment.description: Server-reported product/build comment used with version to identify the dialect.

hostname.description: Database-server hostname reported by @@hostname; not verification of SSH or DNS identity.

server_id.description: Database server identifier returned as XML text; not the source server identifier.

authenticated_user.description: CURRENT_USER() database grant identity; distinct from SSH/effective OS account.

channel.description: One replication channel with source coordinates and filtering evidence.

source_host.description: Replica-reported source hostname; no alias/DNS equivalence inference.

expected_source.description: Saved exact source-host expectation for this channel, or null if no comparison was configured.

io_running.description: Receiver thread state as reported by the server, including Yes, No or Connecting; null if unavailable.

sql_running.description: Applier thread state as reported by the server; null if unavailable.

error_text.description: Redaction marker when an error message was present. Original error SQL/row text is never retained.

source_log_file.description: Source binlog file read by the receiver.

executed_source_log_file.description: Source binlog file currently referenced by the applier.

retrieved_gtid_set.description: MySQL retrieved GTID set as server text; null when unavailable or not applicable.

executed_gtid_set.description: MySQL executed GTID set as server text; no cross-server subset assertion is made.

mariadb_gtid_io_pos.description: MariaDB Gtid_IO_Pos text; not interpreted using MySQL GTID semantics.

mariadb_using_gtid.description: MariaDB Using_Gtid mode as server text.

replicate_do_db.description: Reported database allow filter; empty string means no such filter was reported.

source_port.description: Replica-reported source TCP port; null if unavailable.

delay_seconds.description: Replica-reported Seconds_Behind_Source/Master, not a source-side catch-up or data-equality measurement. Null is unknown.

configured_delay_seconds.description: Configured SQL_Delay. Deliberate delay is not automatically subtracted from the health threshold.

last_io_errno.description: Last receiver error number; zero means no error reported, null means unavailable.

last_sql_errno.description: Last applier error number; zero means no error reported, null means unavailable.

read_source_log_pos.description: Receiver position within source_log_file; not an absolute byte counter across binlog rotations.
read_source_log_pos.unit: bytes within the named binlog file; not across rotations

exec_source_log_pos.description: Applier position within executed_source_log_file; equality with receiver position does not verify source catch-up.
exec_source_log_pos.unit: bytes within the named binlog file; not across rotations

channel.description: Replication connection name; empty string denotes the default channel.

health.description: Observed replica-side health; not source or row consistency.

reasons.description: Saved policy findings; not reevaluated on rebuild.

probe.description: Sanitized command/input/output evidence. Raw stderr and database error text are excluded.

operation.description: Executed client argv with protected option-file path masked, or the reviewed remote-helper invocation description.

input.description: Sanitized stdin/transmission description, including safe saved expectations; never credential values.

sql.description: Exact fixed query or null if the remote helper failed.

exitcode.description: Client exit code; null means unavailable.

oneOf.description: Bounded local client version output; no credential input.

error.description: Safe error type/category or numeric database error category; arbitrary exception/stderr text is excluded.

instance.description: One configured database instance and its independently timed observation.
Operator-selected instance label scoped to this recipe execution on the host.

observed_at.description: Controller UTC timestamp after the probe response; not a database transaction timestamp.

health.description: Observed replica-side health; not source or row consistency.

reason.description: Stable collection/health reason for this instance, including missing expected channel or cleanup uncertainty.

cleanup.description: Whether protected temporary credential cleanup is confirmed.
